name: feature.campaign-playbooks.nodes
description: Campaign playbooks node pack (ADR 0959). Read-only: `read-installation` (which playbook version a client runs, its rollout ring and install history) and `effective-config` (the values the client's installation runs with — the playbook's defaults, then the agency's, then the client's — and its slot bindings), over ctx.features['campaign-playbooks']. Every read is bound to the run's client. Rollouts are human-initiated; no node moves one.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Playbooks: Read installation
nodes.description: Which version of a playbook this client runs, its rollout ring and its install history. Read-only, bound to the run's client. Inputs: { orgId, playbookId }. Output: { installed, playbookId?, version?, ring?, workflowId?, installedVersions? }.

nodes.label: Playbooks: Effective values
nodes.description: The values this client's installation runs with — the playbook's defaults, then the agency's, then the client's — and its slot bindings. Read-only, bound to the run's client. Inputs: { orgId, playbookId }. Output: { version, params, slots }.
